#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <unordered_set>

using namespace std;

const int max_p = 1000000;
const long modulo = 1000000007;

int main()
{
	long long p, k;
	cin >> p >> k;

	if ((k != 1) && (k != 0))
	{
		vector<bool> residue(max_p);
		for (int i = 0; i < p; i++)
			residue[i] = true;

		long long answer = 1;
		for (int i = 1; i < p; i++)
		{
			if (residue[i])
			{
				long long temp = i;
				for (int j = 1; j < p; j++)
				{
					temp = (temp * k) % p;
					if (temp == i)
						break;
					residue[temp] = false;
				}
				answer = (answer * p) % modulo;
			}
		}
		cout << answer << endl;
	}
	else if (k == 1)
	{
		long long answer = 1;
		for (int i = 0; i < p; i++)
			answer = (answer * p) % modulo;
		cout << answer << endl;
	}
	else
	{
		long long answer = 1;
		for (int i = 0; i < p - 1; i++)
			answer = (answer * p) % modulo;
		cout << answer << endl;
	}
	return 0;
}
</perturbed_code_1>
